The '''2016 Copa Sudamericana elimination stages''' were played from 9 August to 15 September 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/listo-el-calendario-de-partidos-de-la-primera-fase-de-la-copa-sudamericana|title=Listo el calendario de partidos de la Primera Fase de la Copa Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=19 July 2016|language=Spanish}}</ref> A total of 46 teams competed in the elimination stages to decide 15 of the 16 places in the [[2016 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2016 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/copa_sudamericana_2016_-_reglamento.pdf|title=Copa Sudamericana 2016 – Reglamento|language=Spanish|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw of the tournament was held on 12 July 2016, 20:00 [[Time in Chile|CLT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the Espacio Riesco Convention and Events Center in [[Huechuraba]], [[Chile]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/se-ultiman-detalles-para-el-sorteo-de-la-copa-sudamericana-en-santiago-de-chile|title=Se ultiman detalles para el sorteo de la Copa Sudamericana en Santiago de Chile|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=5 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/develado-el-camino-de-los-47-equipos-en-la-copa-sudamericana|title=Develado el camino de los 47 equipos en la Copa Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=12 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-direccion-de-competiciones-recuerda-el-cuadro-de-la-fase-final-de-la-sudamericana|title=La Dirección de Competiciones recuerda el cuadro de la fase final de la Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=23 September 2016}}</ref>

For the first stage, the 32 teams were divided into two zones:<ref name="procedures">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/asi-sera-el-sorteo-de-la-copa-sudamericana-2016|title=Así será el sorteo de la Copa Sudamericana 2016|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=11 July 2016}}</ref>
*'''South Zone:''' The 16 teams from Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay were drawn into eight ties.
*'''North Zone:''' The 16 teams from Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela were drawn into eight ties.

Teams which qualified for berths 1 were drawn against teams which qualified for berths 4, and teams which qualified for berths 2 were drawn against teams which qualified for berths 3, with the former hosting the second leg in both cases. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same tie.<noinclude>

For the second stage, the 30 teams, including the 16 winners of the first stage (eight from South Zone, eight from North Zone), whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and the 14 teams which entered the second stage, were divided into three sections:<ref name="procedures"/>
*'''Winners of the first stage:''' The 16 winners of the first stage were drawn into eight ties, with the order of legs decided by draw. Teams from the same association could be drawn into the same tie.
*'''Brazil:''' The eight teams from Brazil were drawn into four ties. Teams which qualified for berths 1–4 were drawn against teams which qualified for berths 5–8, with the former hosting the second leg.
*'''Argentina:''' The six teams from Argentina were drawn into three ties. Teams which qualified for berths 1–3 were drawn against teams which qualified for berths 4–6, with the former hosting the second leg.<noinclude>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the elimination stages (first stage and second stage), each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] would be used. If still tied, [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] would not be played, and the [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 5.1).<ref name="regulations"/> The 15 winners of the second stage (eight from winners of the first stage, four from Brazil, three from Argentina) advanced to the [[2016 Copa Sudamericana final stages|round of 16]] to join the defending champions ([[Independiente Santa Fe|Santa Fe]]).<section end=Format />

==First stage==
The first legs were played on 9–11 August, and the second legs were played on 16–18 August 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/copa_sudamericana_2016_-_fixture_-_primera_fase.pdf|title=Fixture Copa Sudamericana - Primera Fase|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
